top.line: Six setups of an agentic system, from a task to conductors of conductors.
top.para: The altitudes of a run inside each, and command and control growing at every step.

in-short.line: Six setups, prompt against setup, altitudes, danger, reach, and command and control.

setups.line: A task, one agent, sub-agents, several sessions, a conductor and its team, conductors of conductors.
setups.para: The lower three are a prompt; the upper three a setup.

scale.line: At Web Summit the top setup was real: around 250 agents, more than 60 at once.
scale.para: One message to my conductor reached every conductor.

altitudes.line: The altitudes of a run: person, swarm, agent, loop, LLM call, code.
altitudes.para: Two views of the same thing.

control.line: The danger is the same privileges at every altitude; the control is reach.
control.para: Don't hope the agent behaves, make the dangerous thing unreachable.

command.line: The higher the setup, the more you need to see and steer it.
command.para: Command and control is my next memo.

limits.line: A description, figures from the Swarm demo, and a different altitude from decisions.

sources.line: My own thinking and the Swarm repository.
sources.para: With a link to the companion article.
